rationale: Cinematic dark UI (Blueprint Chameleon™) using glassmorphism and editorial typography. Translates the 'PDF -> Entità -> Relazioni' narrative by moving from a raw document view to an interactive, node-like structure where users certify connections.

components.buttons: Monospace uppercase, hollow with accent borders or subtle glass fills
components.badges: Active, clickable states representing pipeline stages

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure cinematic UI feel. Do NOT use white backgrounds. Rely heavily on typography contrast between serif and monospace to differentiate brand data from technical validation states. Every screen must include data-testid attributes for interactive elements.
